dedupe_keys.name: res irf french residential energy model

description: Res-IRF is a Python model developed at CIRED to simulate energy consumption and energy-efficiency improvements in the French residential building sector. It focuses on space heating and combines a detailed representation of dwelling energy performance with household behaviour. The repository includes configuration examples, scripts, notebooks and a documented Conda setup. Runs can compare multiple scenarios and produce detailed CSV outputs, summaries of inputs, graphs and optional pickle files. Coverage is national France at dwelling-stock and household-category level, not a georeferenced asset network; the README does not define a single scenario horizon or observation period. Public source is free under GPL-3.0. Its explicit warning is that repository contents are work in progress and may contain errors; analysis notebooks are also unfinished. Users must inspect scenario assumptions and output definitions before interpreting policy effects. The model supports residential-demand and retrofit-policy simulations. It complements the catalogue's EnergyPlus building model (model-energyplus) by representing stock-level and behavioural change, not detailed heat balances in an individual building.
name: Res-IRF French residential energy model
